notes: Upstream imports NHANES 'imp' data from an external SQLite DB (d:/db/imp.db) via an R bridge (%utl_rbeginx/%utl_rendx + fn_tosas9x.R), lands it as SD1.WANT (33994 x 201), and PROC PRINTs obs=6. SQLite source, R bridge, and d:/ Windows paths are non-portable, so WANT is built inline with the exact NHANES demographic variable shape from the upstream str(readindb)/CONTENTS output (ROWNAMES, ROW_NAMES, SEQN, DMPFSEQ, DMPSTAT, DMARETHN, DMARACER, DMAETHNR), seeded with the SEQN/DMPFSEQ sample values the author records. The author's OBS=6 PROC PRINT runs unmodified; prints 6 of 10 rows.
